# LURI jewels

LURI is an artisanal jewellery studio. This static website provides public information about its collections, individual products, bespoke work, heirloom transformation, materials, shipping, and contact channels.

Primary navigation:
- [Shop all jewellery](https://luri.gold/collections/all)
- [About LURI](https://luri.gold/pages/about)
- [Bespoke jewellery](https://luri.gold/pages/bespoke)
- [Heirloom transformation](https://luri.gold/pages/heirloom-transformation)

Languages:
- [English](https://luri.gold/)
- [German](https://luri.gold/de)
- [Italian](https://luri.gold/it)
